name: SuperTux-PSVITA
description: Wii/PSVITA port of SuperTux Classic (Milestone 1) with extensive bug fixes and performance optimizations
long_description: This is a continuation fork of the original Wii port by scanff and Arikado, available at Google Code archive, of SuperTux Classic (Milestone 1). Originally built with SDL 1.2, this port has been modernized to use SDL2 for Wii. It is designed for use through the Homebrew Channel with OpenGL (via OpenGX) support.
